title: Tenali Rama and the Magic Well
moral: A guilty mind is always afraid.

scenes.summary: A man accuses his neighbor of stealing money.
scenes.text: One day, a man complained to King Krishnadevaraya that his neighbor had stolen his money.
scenes.image_prompt: man accusing neighbor in royal court in front of king cartoon style

scenes.text: The neighbor said he was innocent, and the king could not decide who was telling the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: two men arguing in front of king looking confused cartoon

scenes.summary: Tenali takes them to a well and calls it magical.
scenes.text: Tenali Rama took both men to a well and said it was magical and would reveal the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali standing near a well explaining to two men cartoon

scenes.text: The innocent man dropped a coin confidently, but the guilty man hesitated in fear.
scenes.image_prompt: one man confidently dropping coin while other looks scared near well cartoon

scenes.summary: Tenali identifies the thief and he confesses.
scenes.text: Tenali pointed out the fearful man as the thief. He confessed, and the king praised Tenali. A guilty mind is always afraid.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali pointing at guilty man while king praises him cartoon

story: A man accused his neighbor of theft, but there was no proof. Tenali Rama took them to a well and said it was magical. The innocent man acted confidently, while the guilty man became afraid. Tenali identified the thief, who then confessed.
